mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oms_outbox_event (event_type, order_id, delay_millis, status, attempts, next_attempt_time) VALUES ('ORDER_CANCEL_DELAY', #{orderId}, #{delayMillis}, 'PENDING', 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM oms_outbox_event WHERE (status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND next_attempt_time <= NOW()) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_until <= NOW()) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE oms_outbox_event SET status = 'PROCESSING', attempts = attempts + 1, locked_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{eventId} AND ((status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND next_attempt_time <= NOW()) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_until <= NOW()))
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, delay_millis, status, attempts, next_attempt_time, locked_until, last_error, create_time, update_time FROM oms_outbox_event WHERE id = #{eventId}
mapper.update: UPDATE oms_outbox_event SET status = 'PUBLISHED', locked_until = NULL, last_error = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{eventId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE oms_outbox_event SET status = CASE WHEN attempts >= #{maxAttempts} THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'RETRY' END, next_attempt_time = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{delaySeconds} SECOND), locked_until = NULL, last_error = LEFT(#{error}, 1000), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{eventId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
